purpose: One local32 exact-placement gate transferring the independently confirmed frozen SocketMatcher cyclic-border5 absolute-origin primitive to the confirmed TASKA six-arm layout.
lineage_caveat: This is an opened development gate, not a fresh confirmation: 6/32 local sources occur in frozen Socket checkpoint lineage. Results must be reported both all32 and source-disjoint26; no terminal/fresh panel may be opened without root review.

frozen_rule.candidate_family: all 24x24=576 strict whole-board cyclic row/column rolls of the TASKA control
frozen_rule.tie_break: zero roll starts incumbent; row-major enumeration; replace only on strict gain greater than minimum_gain

no_repeat_distinction: The absolute evidence is the independently trained SocketMatcher real-cut plus four dustbin-border heads, not TASKA raw RGB seam cost.

It is not the prior TASKA structural-border cyclic objective, row-phase DP, whole-layout learned origin, frame-side model, DINO probe, component shift, center-largest-component, coordinate sorter, or monotone placement.
The frozen primitive previously confirmed on Socket decoder layouts; this run changes only the input layout to the stronger confirmed TASKA six-arm board.

metrics.primary: mean exact correct tiles per board
metrics.secondary: mean satisfied adjacent pairs per board

decision.on_fail: stop without tuning weight, gain threshold, roll family, selector, or gate
decision.on_pass: stop and request root review before any terminal or fresh panel
